“`

These two space bracelets, taken from the two invincible Eighth Layer beings Lin Yuan defeated, along with the essence and blood released from the disintegration of their physical bodies and their weapons and treasures, were all collected.

“So wealthy…”

Lin Yuan briefly inspected the haul and a smile emerged on his face.

Within the two space bracelets, the Cosmic Crystals alone amounted to more than two hundred thousand.

Not to mention the other treasures and weapons.

...

If converted into Cosmic Crystals, it too would be a sizable income.

Lin Yuan roughly calculated the total value of the gains from killing the two Eighth Layer invincibles, which was close to five hundred thousand Cosmic Crystals.

Which is to say, on average, each Eighth Layer invincible contributed two hundred and fifty thousand Cosmic Crystals to Lin Yuan.

In fact, this was also the normal worth of an Eighth Layer invincible.

Neither Dark Scale Race Sarath nor the other Eighth Layer invincible had ever considered that anything could go wrong with their mission to assassinate the Milky Way Star Lord.

The Milky Way Star Region was located at the edge of Human Civilization Territory, and the worst outcome would have been the failure of the assassination, allowing them to escape unscathed; they never expected to be completely defeated by Lin Yuan.

Therefore, the avatars of these two Eighth Layer invincibles carried a large number of Cosmic Crystals and treasures, because they perceived there to be no risk in the assassination task.

“Is this… Memory Poison?”

Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly.

Within the space bracelet of Dark Scale Race Sarath, he discovered this peculiar item.

“The Different Species really intend to completely kill me…” Lin Yuan was well aware of the effect of Memory Poison, a remarkable item targeting the memory level, from which not even a ‘resurrection’ by a Supreme Being could save one.

“Unfortunately, Memory Poison is ineffective against me.” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Let alone his surge in strength after the eighth traversal to a level comparable to a Ninth Rank powerhouse.

Even without this traversal, the Soul-Settling Pearl bestowed by Xia Qin Supreme Being would be enough to block the invasion of the Memory Poison.

“Although it’s useless to me, the worth of such a peculiar item is immeasurable.” Lin Yuan carefully stored away the Memory Poison.

…

“I’ve broken even in an instant.” Lin Yuan’s spirit was delighted.

He had just been reluctant to spend eighty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals on the Tai Micro Clear Crystal, but in the blink of an eye, he harvested treasures worth five hundred thousand Cosmic Crystals.

Not only had he recouped his investment, but he also made a substantial profit.

And this was excluding the Memory Poison.

Because Lin Yuan did not know the value of the Memory Poison, but he was certain that it was worth far more than several hundred thousand Cosmic Crystals.

“With this Memory Poison, I could completely kill a peerless genius of a Different Species…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Not just the Insect Race and other Peak Clans that collect the names of human geniuses for their assassination lists, rewarding the killers with generous prizes for each kill.

Human Civilization also compiled lists of peerless geniuses from other Peak Clans, and one could earn a significant number of Merit Points as a reward for permanently eliminating a threat to Human Civilization.

…

“If I had known, I should have kept those three other Eighth Layer invincibles.” Lin Yuan felt some regret, unaware that these Eighth Layer Different Species invaders would carry so many treasures and Cosmic Crystals into the Human Civilization Territory.

…

Virtual World.

Personal Space.

The Chikun Star Lord sat opposite the White Light Star Lord.

“What did you say? The Different Species sent five Eighth Layer invincibles to assassinate my disciple?” The Chikun Star Lord was shocked.

The moment White Light Star Master detected the arrival of the five Eighth Layer invincible aliens outside the Milky Way Main Star, he split off a strand of consciousness into the Virtual World to contact the Chikun Star Lord.

“Don’t worry, I will use the Secret Treasure, White Heart Flame.” White Light Star Lord’s expression was grave.

“White Heart Flame…” The Chikun Star Lord was not reassured.

Once the White Heart Flame was activated, it could indeed unleash a near-Ninth Rank foundational might, but the opponents were five invincible Eighth Layer beings.

If willing to pay the price, they could fully withstand the damage from the White Heart Flame for a short time.

As the Different Species had mobilized five Eighth Layer invincibles, they must be determined to succeed.

“No, I must contact a Supreme Being.” The Chikun Star Lord stood up abruptly.

“Wait.” Suddenly, the White Light Star Lord stopped the Chikun Star Lord.

“`

“`

“Wait, wait for what?” Chikun Star Lord frowned.

“It’s over, those five Eighth Layer Invincible Aliens have retreated.” White Light Star Lord fell silent for a moment, saying somewhat incredulously.

“Retreated?”

Chikun Star Lord was also taken aback.

Although this outcome was unexpected, it also made him breathe a slight sigh of relief.

“Was it one of our human Ninth Rank Evolvers who happened to pass by and saved my disciple?” Chikun Star Lord settled back down, “I, Chikun, must thank them in person.”

In Chikun Star Lord’s view, the only thing that could make five Eighth Layer beings retreat voluntarily was a Ninth Rank Evolver.

As for an Eighth Layer Invincible Evolver from humanity? One or two Invincible Evolvers of the Eighth Layer couldn’t make five Invincible Aliens of the same layer give way.

And five or six Evolvers from human civilization? How could such a coincidence occur? Eighth Layer Invincible Evolvers usually guard the Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield, and without the movement of the three goddesses, they wouldn’t gather together like this.

Therefore, Chikun Star Lord was even more convinced that it was a passing human Ninth Rank Evolver who had acted to save Lin Yuan.

“It wasn’t a Ninth Rank Evolver…” White Light Star Lord fell silent again for a while, then shook his head.

“Not a Ninth Rank Evolver?” Chikun Star Lord exclaimed, “Then which several Eighth Layer Invincibles? I, Chikun, will also personally thank them.”

If it wasn’t a Ninth Rank Evolver, it could only have been a few passing Eighth Layer Invincibles, although this scene was quite incredible, but since it happened, Chikun Star Lord wouldn’t say anything more.

“There were no passing Eighth Layer Invincibles…” White Light Star Lord fell silent for a moment, then spoke again.

Upon hearing this.

Chikun Star Lord fell silent as well.

“Old man, what exactly do you mean?” Chikun Star Lord began to grow impatient.

Continuously denying his guesses without stating the facts, what kind of secret was he trying to sell?

“It was your disciple who repelled those five Eighth Layer Invincibles by himself…” White Light Star Lord looked at Chikun Star Lord with a complex expression.

“It was my disciple… huh… who did you say?” Chikun Star Lord was stunned for a moment, as if not quite catching on.

He understood each word spoken by White Light Star Lord, but strung together they left Chikun Star Lord somewhat baffled.

“I mean, your disciple, on his own, made five Eighth Layer Invincible Aliens retreat voluntarily…” White Light Star Lord repeated.

This time Chikun Star Lord fully grasped the meaning.

He blinked, at a loss for words momentarily.

There were many possibilities for making five Eighth Layer Invincibles retreat voluntarily, but the biggest possibility was that those five Eighth Layer Invincibles felt they could not contend with Lin Yuan, which is why they retreated on their own.

Making an assassination attempt in human territory, even in the Fringe Starfield, those five Eighth Layer Invincibles wouldn’t dare to stay long, and upon realizing it was futile, would decisively give up.

To avoid the arrival of powerful human defenders.

But to achieve this, Lin Yuan himself would have to be an Eighth Layer Invincible as well.

Upon this realization, Chikun Star Lord was filled with emotions. How much time had passed, and the young disciple he had taken in had grown to stand shoulder to shoulder with him?

“Chikun, there’s another matter, I’m not sure if I should mention it…” White Light Star Master glanced at Chikun Star Lord who was looking reflective, and hesitated.

“What could possibly be unspeakable now?” Chikun Star Lord laughed: “My disciple has caught up to me, I should be happy.”

“Your disciple not only made those five Eighth Layer Invincibles retreat voluntarily, but also chased after them and killed two of the Eighth Layer Invincibles…”

White Light Star Lord spoke softly.

“Killed two Eighth Layer Invincibles?”

Chikun Star Lord fell silent once again; even someone as powerful as him could not kill two Eighth Layer Invincibles, let alone having just faced the siege of five such Invincibles.

“Are you sure of what you saw?”

Chikun Star Lord asked somewhat solemnly.

Killing Eighth Layer Invincibles wasn’t an inconceivable event; on the Large Alien Battlefield, every so often an Eighth Layer Invincible would fall.

But the one who killed the Eighth Layer Invincibles was his disciple, a young man who had only stepped into the Eighth Layer a few decades ago, not yet a hundred years of age…

“I am certain.”

White Light Star Lord affirmed.

Though he wasn’t an Eighth Layer Invincible himself, he had a deep understanding of Space Rules, and distance wasn’t an issue for him; he witnessed firsthand those two Eighth Layer Invincible Aliens being slain by the hand of Milky Way Star Master.

“My disciple…”

Upon hearing this, Chikun Star Lord did not doubt it, instead, his face showed a hint of helplessness.

He’d misspoken just a moment ago.

His disciple hadn’t just caught up to him.

He had surpassed him.
